newsitem.title: ITALY: Alleged ally of Mafia boss Brusca gunned down.
newsitem.headline: Alleged ally of Mafia boss Brusca gunned down.

text.p: An alleged member of jailed boss Giuseppe Brusca's clan was shot dead early on Thursday in a typical Mafia killing outside the Sicilian capital, police said.

They said Antonio Di Matteo, 49, was returning home outside Palermo when a car pulled up beside his and the occupants opened fire with a shotgun -- long the weapon of choice for the Mafia's so-called "settling of accounts".
Police said they suspected Di Matteo had been a member of the clan of Brusca, who was arrested earlier this year and is considered one of Sicily's most ferocious Mafia bosses.
Separately, a court on Thursday found 84 people guilty of membership in a Mafia organisation in Italy's southeastern Puglia region.

The court in the region's capital, Bari, sentenced the 84 for crimes ranging from membership in the "Sacred United Crown" crime group in Puglia to attempted murder, extortion, drug-trafficking and theft.
Their jail sentences ranged from six months to 12 years.
The court acquitted 57 people on grounds of lack of evidence. Some of them had been accused of murder.
